caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure with dark brown skin, standing against a plain, light background. The figure is dressed in a white dress with prominent light blue or green plaid patterns and a wide skirt that fans outward, revealing a white underskirt edged in the same plaid pattern. The upper part of the dress features large, voluminous sleeves and a wrap-style bodice, tied at the waist with a sash. The figure wears a headscarf in white with red or orange stripes, tied in a bow at the top of the head. The arms are extended slightly outward, and the hands are visible. The legs of the figure are clad in black stockings, and the feet are wearing brown shoes with pointed toes and low heels. There is no background detail, and the entire composition is centered on the figure. The name "Jacob Gielens" is inscribed below the figure, and handwritten notes appear in the lower right corner.
title: Doll: Black Mama
